def parse_nptable(block: 'BlockParser', m: Match[str], state: 'BlockState'
    ) ->Optional[int]:
    pos = m.end()
    header = m.group('nptable_head')
    align = m.group('nptable_align')
    thead, aligns = _process_thead(header, align)
    if not thead:
        return None
    assert aligns is not None

    rows = []
    body = m.group('nptable_body')
    for text in body.splitlines():
        if not text.strip():
            continue
        row = _process_row(text, aligns)
        if not row:
            return None
        rows.append(row)

    children = [thead, {'type': 'table_body', 'children': rows}]
    state.append_token({'type': 'table', 'children': children})
    return pos


def _process_thead(header: str, align: str) ->Union[Tuple[None, None],
    Tuple[Dict[str, Any], List[str]]]:
    headers = CELL_SPLIT.split(header)[1:-1]
    aligns = CELL_SPLIT.split(align)[1:-1]
    if not headers:
        return None, None

    head = []
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        head.append({
            'type': 'table_cell',
            'text': h.strip(),
            'head': True,
            'align': aligns[i] if i < len(aligns) else None
        })

    return {'type': 'table_head', 'children': head}, aligns


def _process_row(text: str, aligns: List[str]) ->Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    cells = CELL_SPLIT.split(text)[1:-1]
    if not cells:
        return None

    row = []
    for i, c in enumerate(cells):
        row.append({
            'type': 'table_cell',
            'text': c.strip(),
            'head': False,
            'align': aligns[i] if i < len(aligns) else None
        })

    return {'type': 'table_row', 'children': row}


def render_table_cell(renderer: 'BaseRenderer', text: str, align: Optional[
    str]=None, head: bool=False) ->str:
    tag = 'th' if head else 'td'
    if align:
        style = ' style="text-align: %s"' % (
            'center' if ALIGN_CENTER.match(align) else
            'left' if ALIGN_LEFT.match(align) else
            'right'
        )
    else:
        style = ''
    return '<%s%s>%s</%s>\n' % (tag, style, text, tag)


def table(md: 'Markdown') ->None:
    md.block.register_rule('table', TABLE_PATTERN, parse_table)
    md.block.register_rule('nptable', NP_TABLE_PATTERN, parse_nptable)
    md.renderer.register_rule('table', render_table)
    md.renderer.register_rule('table_head', render_table_head)
    md.renderer.register_rule('table_body', render_table_body)
    md.renderer.register_rule('table_row', render_table_row)
    md.renderer.register_rule('table_cell', render_table_cell)


def table_in_quote(md: 'Markdown') ->None:
    """Enable table plugin in quote."""
    md.block.insert_rule(md.block.quote_rules, 'table', before='paragraph')
    md.block.insert_rule(md.block.quote_rules, 'nptable', before='paragraph')
